data: Skeleton entry for /fleet (PRD-012 v0.2 / Phase A scaffold). Builder + agency + first-flight per public sources. Specs and gallery TBD in later phases.

NASA’s nuclear-powered Mars Science Laboratory rover, on Mars since August 2012. Discovered organic molecules, ancient stream-bed environments, and evidence that Mars’ Gale Crater was habitable in the past. Still operational over a decade later.
First nuclear-powered Mars rover; first sky-crane landing
Twin to Spirit; nearly 15-year Mars operation
Proposed NASA rover for the lunar south pole

Mars Science Laboratory. RTG-powered (no solar reliance), car-sized (899 kg), still operational over a decade after landing. Confirmed Gale Crater hosted a habitable lake environment in the deep past. Climbing Mt. Sharp's stratigraphic sequence — billion-year-by-billion-year readings of Mars's environmental history.
